items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: And Eric Garner is popular, you know. He's very famous.

ctx.x: That's right. That's what Eric Garner says now. Eric Garner says he plays the piano and have somebody around to catch the night. Because he doesn't know music at all.

He doesn't write music or even know music. And Eric Garner is popular, you know. He's very famous. You know Eric Garner, yes. And my little grandson, at one of the concerts, he played whispering. He was one of his numbers, you know. So did your, you say your brother, you told me before, your brother didn't read music much at first, but he ever listened to him? Oh, yeah. I mean, yes, indeed. I was a kid.
I was a kid. I was a kid. I was a kid. I was a kid.
